svg.title: InsightPilot — proposed layered system architecture
svg.desc: One diagram inspired by the reference workbook. Six tiers show components, functions and technologies; future scope uses dashed borders. External model provider is outside the customer boundary.
svg.text: Proposed design · Layered, agent-orchestrated architecture · CMPE 295A + 295B scope
CUSTOMER ENVIRONMENT — ONE ORGANISATION · SELF-HOSTED / DOCKER COMPOSE
Clarify ambiguity; edit and approve plans
SPECIALIST AGENT TIER — ALL TASKS AND RESULTS ROUTED THROUGH ORCHESTRATOR
VERIFICATION & LINEAGE TIER — CHECKS USE SQL / COMPUTE, NEVER LLM SELF-CRITIQUE
Record query, grain, checks and skips
INTEGRATION TIER — READ-ONLY SOURCES; SEMANTIC DEFINITIONS HAVE SEPARATE PRECEDENCE
durable bindings, state, lineage and audit
KEY: Solid box = 295A scope; dashed box + [295B/later] = future scope. Solid arrow = requests/data; dashed arrow = control/response.
AGENT CONTROL: No direct agent-to-agent calls. Failed checks halt downstream work; 295B adds capped replanning / partial-result exit.
READING: Arrows summarise tier interactions, not execution order. Analyst sign-off precedes export. DAG = directed acyclic graph; PII = personal information.
Reference layout: AI Agent Marketplace workbook, Chapter 5, page 18. Technologies and scope: InsightPilot workbook Chapter 5 / architecture D01–D10.
